title: SkillPrivus: Uncovering PRIVacy of USe Harms in Agentic Skills
abstract: arXiv:2611.26747v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent skills extend AI assistants through installable instructions and code that can access users' files, accounts, and data. Even when performing their advertised tasks, skills may infer sensitive attributes, retain unnecessary information, or disclose data to unexpected recipients. We study these potential privacy-of-use harms through SkillPrivus, a static audit framework that analyzes skills before installation without executing them. SkillPrivus extracts data operations from code and natural-language instructions, grounds them in source evidence, and adapts Contextual Integrity to assess their appropriateness. Applied to 726 real skills from public marketplaces, 563 of which handle personal data, SkillPrivus flags at least one potential violation in 307 of these skills (54.5%), and its judgments agree with three blind human annotators on 83.2% of resolvable moves. translated_title: SkillPrivus：揭示智能体技能中的使用隐私危害
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.26747v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：智能体技能通过可安装的指令和代码来扩展 AI 助手，这些指令和代码能够访问用户的文件、账户和数据。即使技能在执行其宣称的任务时，也可能推断出敏感属性、保留不必要的信息，或向意料之外的接收方披露数据。我们通过 SkillPrivus 研究这些潜在的“使用隐私”危害——这是一个静态审计框架，可以在不执行技能的情况下于安装前对其进行分析。SkillPrivus 从代码和自然语言指令中提取数据操作，将其锚定于源证据，并引入情境完整性理论来评估其适当性。将该框架应用于来自公开市场的 726 个真实技能（其中 563 个涉及个人数据处理），SkillPrivus 在其中 307 个技能（54.5%）中标记出至少一个潜在违规行为，其判断在 83.2% 的可判定数据操作上与三位盲评人类标注者一致。被标记的行为包括敏感推断、信息使用……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SkillPrivus 是一个无需执行即可在安装前对智能体技能进行静态隐私审计的框架，对 726 个真实技能的分析发现超过半数（54.5%）存在潜在隐私违规。
en_tdlr: SkillPrivus is a static audit framework that uncovers privacy-of-use harms in agentic skills before installation without execution, flagging potential privacy violations in 54.5% of 726 real marketplace skills.
